text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Wah, look at that! The crane game is 
packed full of Paka Puchi plushies!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking in the direction Narita Top Road 
points, there is a crane game filled with 
plushies themed after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'll take on the challenge! And then— I'll 
get more friends for the Paka Petit 
plushie that the fans gave me...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... total defeat...!! I didn't even 
graze the plushie!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... How on earth do you get the claw 
to go where you actually want it to...?
choice_data_list: Want me to get it for you instead?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Really...!? Please, please teach me!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
All to turn the Paka Puchi collection in 
my room into a giant family!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
